Phase-by-Phase Read

PhaseVerdictWhat the model showsWhat the target changes
Load & stride Keep Balanced setup, bat stays loaded, controlled stride — front knee bends to ~130-150° (measured), no lunging. Nothing structural. The target only changes when the hips start turning, not the stride itself.
Swing & contact Adjust Hips and shoulders arrive nearly together, and contact happens out in front of the plate — several of these swings became fouls. Hips open a beat earlier than the shoulders (stretch-and-fire), and the ball is met slightly deeper in the zone — the Sierra Romero "let it travel" cue from her report.
Extension Keep Her best trait on film: full arm extension over a firm front leg — knee straightens to ~155-180° through contact (measured, every real swing). Unchanged. This is the part of her swing that already looks like the target.
Follow-through Keep Full, balanced finish, matching the strong extension. Unchanged.

Verdicts and adjustments mirror the checklist scores and the primary-issue diagnosis in her full scouting report — this page is a visual companion to those, not a separate opinion. All of it is an unconfirmed AI draft until a coach signs off.
